seo.title: Obergurgl ski resort guide
seo.description: 112 km of slopes and 25 lifts between 1,800 and 3,030 metres at the head of the Ötztal, with skiing from November to April.

seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Obergurgl-Hochgurgl in Tyrol.

h1: Obergurgl ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Obergurgl sits at the closed head of the Ötztal at just over 2,000 metres, and the ski area above it runs from 1,800 to 3,030 metres - high enough that the operator states a hundred per cent snow guarantee and skiing from November to April. Two linked areas, Obergurgl at 1,930 metres and Hochgurgl at 2,150 metres, hold roughly 56 kilometres of slopes each, joined by the Top Express across the Konigstal and Ferwalltal valleys in nine minutes.
stayOverview: Two villages, both on the slopes: Obergurgl at 1,930 metres is the larger one with the village centre, and Hochgurgl at 2,150 metres is smaller, higher and quieter. The Top Express links them in nine minutes.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Both villages put you on the snow; Obergurgl has more to walk to in the evening.
rentalCars: Obergurgl is at the end of the Ötztal road, about 90 minutes from Innsbruck and reached through Sölden.

dayPass.value: From EUR 75.50 for an adult in peak season
dayPass.note: Cash-desk rates for the Gurgl area: from EUR 64.00 pre-season (19 November to 4 December 2026), from EUR 69.50 in high season and from EUR 75.50 at peak (19 December to 6 January and 30 January to 26 February). Booking early online costs less.
